title: I Used Agent Skills to Fine-Tune an Open-Source LLM on Nebius Token Factory
blurb: A teacher-student distillation walkthrough for an insurance-claims chatbot, using Token Factory Data Lab batch inference, LoRA fine-tuning, serverless adapter deployment, and a Gradio comparison app. Ships with a companion Jupyter notebook.

title: Building a Multi-Agent RAG System with Couchbase, CrewAI, and Nebius AI Studio
blurb: Build a semantic search engine that pairs Couchbase as the vector store with CrewAI multi-agent RAG, using Nebius AI Studio for both the Llama LLM and the e5-mistral embeddings.

title: Fine-Tune Your LLM in Minutes with Nebius
blurb: A practical guide to fine-tuning open-source LLMs on Nebius three ways: the no-code Web Console, the Python SDK, and raw cURL API requests, with .jsonl dataset prep.

title: Text-to-SQL: Creating Embeddings with Nebius AI Studio (Part 1)
blurb: Part 1 of a text-to-SQL RAG series: turn SQL schema into annotated markdown and generate vector embeddings with Nebius AI Studio (BAAI/bge-en-icl), stored in Postgres with pgvector.

title: Text-to-SQL: Generating SQL with Nebius AI Studio (Part 2)
blurb: Part 2 of the text-to-SQL RAG series: use the embeddings from Part 1 to retrieve relevant schema and generate correct SQL queries with Nebius AI Studio models.

title: Text-to-SQL: Querying Databases with Nebius AI Studio and Agents (Part 3)
blurb: Part 3 of the text-to-SQL RAG series: wrap the pipeline in an agent that queries a live database end to end, powered by Nebius AI Studio models.

title: Using Nebius AI Models with LangChain/LangGraph via LiteLLM
blurb: Wire Nebius-hosted Qwen models into LangChain/LangGraph through LiteLLM, then build a ReAct agent that talks to databases over the Model Context Protocol.

title: How I Built an Agentic RAG App to Brainstorm Conference Talk Ideas
blurb: Combine Tavily live web research, Couchbase vector search over past KubeCon talks, and Nebius AI Studio (e5-mistral embeddings + Qwen3) to synthesize unique conference talk abstracts.

title: Create Your Own AI-Powered Code Generator and Reviewer
blurb: Build a full-stack Next.js code assistant that generates snippets across languages and returns automated reviews, powered by DeepSeek Coder on Nebius Token Factory.

title: Building an AI-Powered Finance Planner with Full-Stack Next.js and Nebius
blurb: Step-by-step build of Money-Guard, a Next.js dashboard that analyzes spending and answers questions about transactions using Meta Llama 3.1 70B served by Nebius AI Studio.

title: How to Run Meta Llama 3.1 405B with the Nebius AI Studio API
blurb: A hands-on how-to for calling Meta Llama 3.1 405B through the Nebius OpenAI-compatible API, with working Python, JavaScript, and cURL examples.

title: Build a Job-Finding Agent with Google ADK, Nebius AI, Mistral OCR & Linkup
blurb: A multi-agent pipeline that reads resume PDFs with Mistral OCR, searches live job boards via Linkup, and uses Qwen3-14B on Nebius AI Studio to generate and filter matches, orchestrated with Google ADK.

title: I Built a Team of 5 Agents Using Google ADK, Meta Llama and Nemotron-Ultra-253B
blurb: Build an AI Trend Analyzer with five sequential ADK agents (Exa, Tavily, Firecrawl + summary/analysis) running Meta Llama 3.1 and Nemotron-Ultra-253B served through Nebius AI Studio.

title: Use DeepSeek R1 & V3 with Bolt.DIY & Cursor in 3 Steps
blurb: Get free Nebius AI Studio API keys, route DeepSeek R1/V3 through OpenRouter, and plug the EU-hosted models into Bolt.DIY and Cursor for coding.
